speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. You mentioned a pruritic rash on your bilateral upper extremities; can you tell me how long you have had these symptoms and if they are itchy or painful?

speaker: Patient
text: 23-year-old female. The patient complains of a pruritic rash on both upper extremities that has been present for 5 months. She notes that the rash occasionally worsens but has not completely resolved at any point. She denies any recent illnesses and mentions that she has not started any new medications or come into contact with any new substances that she is aware of.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Atopic dermatitis.

Based on your history of a chronic, itchy rash on your arms that persists for five months without a clear trigger, this presentation is most consistent with atopic dermatitis. Do you have a personal or family history of asthma or hay fever?
